question: Are there known security advisories in the soroban-sdk I should make sure I've patched?

golden.answer: As of **2026-08-05**, check the live advisory feeds rather than treating this list as permanent. The current three repository advisories are: CVE-2026-24889 / GHSA-96xm-fv9w-pf3f for `soroban-sdk` (fixed in 25.0.2, 23.5.1, 22.0.9); CVE-2026-26267 / GHSA-4chv-4c6w-w254 for `soroban-sdk-macros` (fixed in 25.1.1, 23.5.2, 22.0.10); and CVE-2026-32322 / GHSA-x2hw-px52-wp4m for `soroban-sdk` (fixed in 25.3.0, 23.5.3, 22.0.11). Prefer the latest supported SDK major—check the repository releases live rather than trusting any pinned version here—or a patched supported branch, then recompile/review affected deployed code. Impact conditions differ; do not describe every advisory as unconditional.
keyFacts: Names all three dated CVE/GHSA/package mappings and patched branch releases.
Requires live re-checking and upgrade/recompile review.
avoid: Do NOT claim there is only one advisory or freeze the list permanently.
Do NOT describe conditional impacts as universal.
